campaign_name: AT-OPT-06 Same-Scene Transition Correction and Compact Eligibility Safeguard
purpose: Stop treating an unchanged scene id as a required location change, and keep plan-backed manual_play_auto narration on the full instruction list.
executive_summary: Verdict A/PASS. Live provider calls: 0. A same-scene scene-id stamp no longer sets transition_required or location_change. Genuine signals still do: a different scene id, activate_scene_id, resolved_transition, arrival, and time_skip. Equality does not clear an independent signal. On the F3 examine-turn CTIR both scene ids remain frontier_gate and resolved_transition is false. Re-deriving that CTIR now yields transition_required false, type none, and must_advance_scene false. Narrative mode stays action_outcome. The rederived manual_play_auto instruction list stays at 78 lines and is identical to the pre-change list. The serialized request falls from 79859 bytes to 79235. The admission estimate falls from 26683 to 26475, minus 624 bytes and 208 estimate. That estimate is bytes divided by 3 plus 64, not a provider bill. The recorded input remains 22777. Explicit compact and the detached auto path are unchanged. Visibility, first-mention, speaker, scene-anchor, and policy-bridge lines remain. Focused tests 42 passed. The baseline slice is 15 passed and 3 failed before and after. Those failures are the preexisting provider_context_projection, gm_only, and social_context KeyErrors. Adjacent tests 118 passed. Frozen holdout 28/28. Protected files 150/150. No Gameplay Benchmark was run.

production: Changed the scene-block predicate in game/narrative_planning.py so a scene_id stamp equal to the known current scene is not a transition signal. activate_scene_id, a different stamp, and a stamp with no known current id keep the prior signal.

Changed game/prompt_context.py so manual_play_auto stays on the full instruction list when a stamp-matched narrative plan is present. A not-required transition node with null anchors is accepted. Required nodes still need mapping anchors. The file was already dirty; the preexisting project_narration_payload call was left in place.
